chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin ka ta aw, nang na hihleh Khris Jesu' sunga om hehpihna tawh thadimin na om in.
Teci tampitak' mai-a kei' tungpan na zaksa thute, a muanhuai mite' tungah apsawn in.
Khris Jesu' galkap hoih khat hihna tawh gimna hong thuakkhawm in.
Galkap sunga a sem peuhmah galkap thak a khawmpa a lungkimsak zawh nadingin nisim nuntakvai thute lakah va kipaikan lo hi.
Kimawlmi zong thukhun zui-in a kidem keileh pahtawina lukhu kipia lo hi.
Nasep a hahkat lokhomi zong gahleteh hawm masak a ngah dingin kilawm hi.
Topa in na khempeuh ah theihtelna hong guan ding ahih manin ka gen thu limtak ngaihsun in.
Jesu Khris phawk in. Lungdamna Thu tangkona ah ka gen mah bangin amah pen misite' lakpan a thokik, David' suan ahi hi.
Tua Lungdamna Thu' hangin khutkhial migilo khat bangin kolbulh khaukhihna zah dong gimsiatna ka thuak hi. Ahih hangin Pasian' thu kikhihcip lo hi.
Tua ahih manin teeltuam mite in Khris Jesu' sunga om, tawntung minpha tawh kithuah hotkhiatna a ngah theih nadingun amaute' adingin na khempeuh ka thuak hi.
Hih thugenna a muantaak thu ahi hi: Amah tawh i sihkhop leh amah tawh i nungtakhawm ding hi.
I thuakzawh leh amah tawh i ukkhawm ding hi. Amah i nolh leh amah'n zong ei hong nolh ding hi.
Pasian amahleamah kinolh theilo ahih manin ei i ciampel zongin amah ciamkip veve hi.
Hih thu teng amaute phawkkiksak inla, kam a kinialnial loh nadingun Pasian' mai-ah khauhtakin gen in. Tua bangte in phattuamna piangsak lo-in a za mite' lungsim kisiasak leltak hi.
Nang na hihleh thumaan thutak maantakin khentel inla, maizum nading a neilo, pahtak a ngah nasem khat bangin Pasian' mai-ah na kiluui zawh nadingin na hihtheihtawp hanciam in.
A biaknavailo thu kihaikupnate peel in. A hang pen tuate in kihtakbei gamtatna khangsak semsem a,
tua mite' thugen pen gangrene bangin kizel ding hi. Tuate' lakah Hymenaeus leh Philetus zong kihel uh hi.
Tua mite thumaan thutak pan pialkhia khinta uh a, thawhkikna tung khinzo ci uh ahih manin mi kimkhatte upna thu ah buaisak uh hi.

Himah taleh Pasian' khuambul kip pen khauhtak a kiphut hi a, tua tungah, “Topa in ama' a ahite thei hi,” cih leh, “Topa' min a pulakte khempeuh diklohna pan kilehkik ding uh hi,” cih ciaptehna gip kibelh hi.
Tu-in innpum a golpi khat sungah vanzatte pen kham leh ngun tawh a kibawlte bek hilo-in sing leh tungman tawh a kibawlte zong om hi. Kimkhatte thupizat nam hi a, kimkhatte tangzangzat nam ahi hi.

Tua ahih manin mi khatpeuh tangzangzat dinmun pan amahmah kihahsiang hileh thupizat nam suak ding a, a siangtho dinga kituamkoih, inntekpa' zat dinga kilawm, nahoih sepna a namkim' adingin a kigingsa, hiding hi.
Tua ahih manin khangnovai cilesa lunggulhnate peel inla, lungsim siangtho tawh Topa' kianga thungente, tua mite tawh kithuahin diktatna, ciamkipna, itna leh nopna lemna sulzuih in.
A haivai, theihloh huhau-a thu a maanzaw kituhna cihte tawh kipaikan kei in. Tuate in kitotna piangsak cih na theih ahi hi.
Topa' sila cih pen kitot hat lo-in mi khempeuh tungah a migi hiding a, hilhcian a siam, mi' khialhna a thuakzo,
amah a langbawlte' khialhna thunem tawh a puah thei, hiding hi. Tua hileh Pasian in tua mite thumaan thutak cingtaaktak a theih nadingun kisikna lungsim guankha thei ding a,
tua mite zong a lungsim uh hong navak kikin dawimangpa' deihna bang a gamta dingin matcip a thuakna mun uh, tua dawimangpa' thangzak pan hong suakta theikha ding uh hi.
